```{r ,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=7,fig.width=7, out.width="67%"}

library(ggplot2)
library(extrafont)
loadfonts()


effects_model2 = readRDS("../../Data/Working_files/effects_model2.rds")

# Plot
ggplot(effects_model2, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = as.factor(group2))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#482677ff", "#29af7fff", "#F0D229")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#482677ff", "#29af7fff", "#F0D229")) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = as.factor(group2)), alpha = 0.4, color = NA) +
  labs(x = "",
       y = NULL,
       color = "",
       fill = "") +
  facet_wrap(~ BothLabels, ncol = 3) + # Keep 3 columns for a 3x3 layout
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black",family = "Helvetica"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
       panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=2)) +
scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0,20,40))



```
